title: Bring Apple Fitness+ to Egypt!
body:
The app is great, it counts the steps taken, calories burned, etc. It also supports workouts and streaks with achievement to unlock. I'm pretty sure it becomes much better with an Apple Watch as well.

But I'm leaving 4 stars cuz despite being an Apple One subscriber, Fitness+ is yet to be available. Which is weird because there is no reason not to! I hope Apple brings Fitness+ to Egypt. Thanks!
